title: A network of DZF proteins controls alternative splicing regulation and fidelity
authors: Haque N; Will A; Cook AG; Hogg JR
one_liner_zh: 该文研究DZF蛋白通过dsRNA结合调控可变剪接，虽涉及RNA结合蛋白，但对象为RNA而非DNA，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题TF-DNA互作无关。
abstract: Proteins containing DZF ( d omain associated with z inc fingers) modules play important roles throughout gene expression, from transcription to translation. Derived from nucleotidyltransferases but lacking catalytic residues, DZF domains serve as heterodimerization surfaces between DZF protein pairs. Three DZF proteins are widely expressed in mammalian tissues, ILF2, ILF3, and ZFR, which form mutually exclusive ILF2-ILF3 and ILF2-ZFR heterodimers. Using eCLIP-Seq, we find that ZFR binds across broad intronic regions to regulate the alternative splicing of cassette and mutually exclusive exons. ZFR preferentially binds dsRNA in vitro and is enriched on introns containing conserved dsRNA elements in cells. Many splicing events are similarly altered upon depletion of any of the three DZF proteins; however, we also identify independent and opposing roles for ZFR and ILF3 in alternative splicing regulation. Along with widespread involvement in cassette exon splicing, the DZF proteins control the fidelity and regulation of over a dozen highly validated mutually exclusive splicing events. Our findings indicate that the DZF proteins form a complex regulatory network that leverages dsRNA binding by ILF3 and ZFR to modulate splicing regulation and fidelity.
abstract_zh: 含有DZF（与锌指结构域相关的结构域）模块的蛋白质在基因表达过程中，从转录到翻译，扮演着重要角色。DZF结构域源自核苷酸转移酶，但缺乏催化残基，作为DZF蛋白对之间的异二聚化表面。三种DZF蛋白在哺乳动物组织中广泛表达，即ILF2、ILF3和ZFR，它们形成互斥的ILF2-ILF3和ILF2-ZFR异二聚体。通过eCLIP-Seq技术，我们发现ZFR结合于广泛的内含子区域，调控盒式外显子和互斥外显子的选择性剪接。ZFR在体外优先结合双链RNA（dsRNA），并在细胞中富集于含有保守dsRNA元件的内含子上。许多剪接事件在三种DZF蛋白中任一缺失时均发生类似改变；然而，我们也识别出ZFR和ILF3在选择性剪接调控中的独立且相反的作用。除了广泛参与盒式外显子剪接外，DZF蛋白还控制着超过十二个高度验证的互斥剪接事件的保真度和调控。我们的发现表明，DZF蛋白形成了一个复杂的调控网络，利用ILF3和ZFR的dsRNA结合能力来调节剪接调控和保真度。
